title: Geometric presentations and normalized resolving tensor comparisons on sequence sites
statement: For arbitrary natural-number commutative ring sequence A with adjacent maps δ, let T assign TensorConstraints to each scheme W, in the precise sense of [def-pur-diagram-pullback-shift-data]. There exists Models S with S.constraints = T. Thus its pullbacks have the canonical constant-ring components and specified direct images, unit normalization and exactness; its tensor comparisons preserve resolving inputs and satisfy the representative square; its compositors are adjunction mates and have the displayed section formula. This assertion asks for no chain or derived shift coherence beyond the data already required by the structures.

proof.text: Use the entire vertical sequence site and the existing base-change functor. The constant-ring maps are natural in every adjacent coefficient map; inverse image of this ring tower identifies with the target tower. The geometric set inverse-image adjunction gives the algebraic module inverse image and its scalar-extension presentation. Its right adjoint is the specified module pushforward, and transposing generators identifies the adjunction unit with the set unit and q. Constant-ring inverse image is exact; its left adjoint preserves colimits.

The right-adjoint compositor acts on sections by pullbackComp.inv. Conjugate it through the set and module adjunctions; both composite unit routes insert 1 on generators, giving scalarAssociation. This provides the section-normalized CompositePresentation.

Apply canonical ringed-topos tensor pullback on each diagram site. It preserves flat-term K-flat inputs and supplies the unique comparison with its canonical total-tensor representative square. Set the constraints field to the given T and assemble Models.
